book_intro: The calendar below reflects current availability. Dates are held only once a booking request has been confirmed in writing.
book_side_text: Every rental to date has begun with a call or a text. Inquiries reach the owner directly and are answered in person rather than routed through a form.
rule_driver: A valid standard driver's license is sufficient; no CDL is required. Additional drivers must be named on the rental agreement.
rule_insurance: Proof of insurance required before pickup.
rule_smoking: Smoking and vaping are prohibited inside the vehicle at all times. A violation forfeits the security deposit.
rule_pets: Pet friendly — dogs welcome with a $125 fee. No cats.
rule_generator: 6 generator hours / day included. Campground quiet hours, typically 10pm–7am, must be observed.
rule_return: 6 PM end time. A 90-minute grace period applies, after which $50 per hour or part hour is charged.
